description: Generate a value-added transcript with timestamped segments, SRT/VTT, language detection, word count and duration (optional summary). 0.005 USDC/started minute (min 0.005); 3 free/day. Pass url, upload_id (from speech_upload_url), or audioBase64 — WAV/MP3/M4A/MP4/WebM/OGG/FLAC you have the right to process. Platform pages refused. Max 10 min / 25 MB. Price = max(declared, parsed, 16 kbps floor).

durationSeconds.description: Declared duration hint in seconds (cannot underprice; we parse the file).

language.description: Optional language hint (e.g. en, zh). If omitted we detect language.

summary.description: If true, include a short 1–3 sentence summary.

uploadId.description: upload_id from speech_upload_url after a successful PUT (single-use).

url.description: HTTPS direct media file URL you have the right to process (audio/* or video/*; MP3/M4A/MP4/WebM/WAV/…). Not a YouTube/Instagram/TikTok/Facebook/X/Vimeo page.

name: speech_transcribe
title: Transcribe audio to text + subtitles
